title: Learning platform: the as-is ecosystem blueprint
subtitle: Six systems hand-shaking beneath the learner across six lifecycle stages. The scoping workshop mapped the journey one system at a time; the failure points are where the business case's ticket classes came from.

lanes.name: HR system
cells: Account link fails at creation || The largest ticket class, raised before the learner ever logged in.

lanes.name: Recruiting platform
cells: Profile hand-off || The new-hire record must reach the learning systems; failures strand access.

lanes.name: Identity and single sign-on
cells: Dual sign-in paths || Two routes into the same content; forgotten-path tickets.

lanes.name: Legacy front end
cells: Unfiltered content wall || Every course visible to every learner: wrong completions, training on equipment the store lacks.
No sequencing at enrolment || Everything available on day one: wrong-order and skipped training.

lanes.name: Learning back end
cells: Completions not recorded across systems || Marked complete on one system, missing on the other: certification gaps.
Reporting limited to one role || No oversight, no expiry tracking, no audit trail for recertification.

lanes.name: People platform
cells: No age data fed in || Age-restricted training ungated; interim confirmation gate while the data fix lands.

lanes.name: Failure points
cells: F-01 Account links || Tickets before the first login.
F-02 Dual sign-in || Confusion and forgotten-path tickets.
F-03 Content wall || Wrong completions; wrong-equipment certification.
F-04 No sequencing || Skipped and wrong-order training.
F-05 Sync failures || Certification gaps and progression delays.
F-06 Reporting rights || No oversight; no audit trail.

footer: KFC South Pacific, 2024 to 2025. Drawn by Sam Mozaffari from the scoping workshop output; vendors and people removed. Rendered September 2026.
